Vs.
ADC (Rev) Pabna for Vested and Non-Resident Property (Land and Building) Pabna & others ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 2. Plaintiffs suit, in short, is that the suit land belonged to Suphir Kumar Lahiri. Abdul Gafur took settlement of the suit land from said Suphir Kumar Lahiri on 10th Asar 1353 BS. Abdur Gafur filed Other Class suit No. 178 of 1969 for declaration of his title and got an ex parte decree. Plaintiff has purchased the suit land from said Abdul Gafur in the year 1980 and got possession in the suit land and he is still holding ownership. The suit land, according to the plaintiff, was wrongly recorded in the name of Suphir Kumar Lahiri in SA Khatian and, as such, it was listed illegally as vested and non-resident property in case No. 159 of 1966-67. So the suit has been filed for declaration of title. Defendant Government contested by filing written statement.Defendant's case is that Suphir Kumar Lahiri, the original owner of the suit land, left this country in the year 1965 and, as such, the suit property was made at first enemy property vide enemy property case in 1965-68 and thereafter vested and non-resident property in the aforesaid case made on 20-2-82. Abdul Gafur got a fraudulent ex parte decree in his said Other Class suit No.178 of 1969 collusively and subsequently the plaintiff obtained the deed of purchase of the suit land fraudulently and collusively which does not impart any title to the plaintiff. It is on record that the suit property was made enemy property by order dated 3-12-65 in EP case No. 195. Subsequently it, by operation of law, became vested and non-resident property. Ext. (A) shows that Abdul Gafur vendor of the plaintiff had knowledge of the same. The plaintiff himself also knew the same. Subsequent transfer by Abdul Gafur to the plaintiff is therefore fraudulent one and without lawful authority. The plaintiff and other persons unsuccessfully tried to get release of the property alleging that they took pattan from Suphir Kumar Lahiri.
